Maverick is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. Maverick allows liquidity providers to place directional liquidity positions that move with the price. Maverick operates without intermediaries on public blockchains.

Icecream swap is a decentralized exchange that uses an automated market maker model. Icecream swap operates on public blockchains without intermediaries. Icecream swap enables token swaps through liquidity pools.

StableSwap is an automated market maker invariant designed for assets of similar value. StableSwap combines a constant sum and a constant product component. StableSwap is used in Curve Finance liquidity pools for stablecoins.

USDC/USDT is a trading pair of two stablecoins pegged to the US dollar. USDC/USDT pairs USDC, a stablecoin issued by Circle, with USDT, a stablecoin issued by Tether. USDC/USDT trades with low price volatility between its two components.

Bancor protocol is an automated market maker protocol that uses liquidity pools for token conversions. Bancor protocol supports single-sided liquidity provision. Bancor protocol operates on public blockchains without intermediaries.
